answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The vine is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the gale. Reaching the lantern of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
